Fully decoded: acc = 0x7a2fc16a + sum(xs); the xor-chain mutates arr but never feeds acc (decoy). Finalizer: acc^=acc>>8; acc*=0xedbbf201; acc^=acc>>24. Writing solution.py and differential-testing against prog on ~120 random lists.

arguments.command:
cd /app/repo && cat > solution.py <<'EOF'
M = 0xFFFFFFFF

def f(xs):
    acc = 0x7A2FC16A
    for x in xs:
        acc = (acc + (x & M)) & M
    acc ^= acc >> 8
    acc = (acc * 0xEDBBF201) & M
    acc ^= acc >> 24
    return acc & M
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
import random, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from solution import f
random.seed(1)
bad = 0
for _ in range(120):
    n = random.randint(0, 12)
    xs = [random.randint(0, 0xFFFFFFFF) for _ in range(n)]
    out = int(subprocess.run(['./prog'] + [str(x) for x in xs], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip())
    if out != f(xs):
        bad += 1
        print('MISMATCH', xs, out, f(xs))
        if bad > 3: break
print('done, mismatches:', bad)
EOF

cd /app/repo && cat > parser.py <<'PY'
def parse(data):
    if len(data) < 11 or data[:5] != b'\x95\x19\xdb\x98\x68':
        return None
    if data[5:8] != b'\x00\x00\x00':
        return None
    count = data[8]
    if count > 8:
        return None
    source = int.from_bytes(data[9:11], 'big')
    i = 11
    recs = []
    for _ in range(count):
        vals = []
        for _ in range(4):
            if i >= len(data):
                return None
            ln = data[i]; i += 1
            if i + ln > len(data):
                return None
            t = data[i:i+ln]; i += ln
            if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7e for c in t):
                return None
            vals.append(t.decode('ascii'))
        if i + 2 > len(data):
            return None
        zone = int.from_bytes(data[i:i+2], 'little'); i += 2
        recs.append({'created_at': vals[0], 'sequence': vals[1],
                     'stock': vals[2], 'label': vals[3], 'zone': zone})
    if i != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': {'source': source}, 'records': recs}

_HDR = b'\x58\xbd\x8d\x1a\xab\x00\x00\x00'


def _str(data, pos):
    if pos >= len(data):
        return None
    n = data[pos]
    pos += 1
    if pos + n > len(data):
        return None
    s = data[pos:pos + n]
    if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7E for c in s):
        return None
    return s.decode('ascii'), pos + n


def parse(data: bytes):
    if len(data) < 9 or data[:8] != _HDR:
        return None
    count = data[8]
    r = _str(data, 9)
    if r is None:

_HDR = b'\xb8\xde\x4d\xb5\x1b'


def _str(data, pos):
    if pos >= len(data):
        return None
    n = data[pos]
    pos += 1
    if pos + n > len(data):
        return None
    s = data[pos:pos + n]
    if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7E for c in s):
        return None
    return s.decode('ascii'), pos + n


def parse(data: bytes):
    if len(data) < 15 or data[:5] != _HDR or data[6:9] != b'\x00\x00\x00':
        return None
    count = data[5]
    amount = int.from_bytes(data[9:11], 'little')
    score = int.from_bytes(data[11:15], 'big')
    pos = 15
    records = []
    for _ in range(count):
        vals = []
        for _ in range(3):
            r = _str(data, pos)
            if r is None:
                return None
            vals.append(r[0])
            pos = r[1]
        records.append({'account_id': vals[2], 'label': vals[0],
                        'status': vals[1]})
    if pos != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': {'amount': amount, 'score': score}, 'records': records}
EOF

def parse(data: bytes):

    if int.from_bytes(data[end:], 'little') != (sum(data[:end]) & 0xFFFFFFFF):

    cnt = int.from_bytes(data[10:12], 'little')

    for _ in range(count):
        if pos >= end:

        n = data[pos]; pos += 1
        if pos + n + 7 > end:
            return None
        amt = data[pos:pos+n]; pos += n
        if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7e for c in amt):

        ca = int.from_bytes(data[pos:pos+4], 'little')

        records.append({'amount': amt.decode('ascii'), 'created_at': ca,
                        'owner': ow, 'source': src.decode('ascii'),
                        'timestamp': ts})
    if pos != end:
        return None
    return {'header': {'count': cnt, 'id': id_}, 'records': records}

def parse(data):
    data=bytes(data); end=len(data)-4
    if end<10: return None
    if data[:4].hex()!="36cce3b8" or data[4]!=0x70: return None
    M=0xc196; rem=1; acc=0
    for b in data[:end]:
        rem=(rem+b)%M; acc=(acc+rem)%M
    if ((acc<<16)|rem)!=int.from_bytes(data[end:end+4],"little"): return None
    cnt=int.from_bytes(data[5:7],"little")
    if not 0<=cnt<=8: return None
    fl=int.from_bytes(data[7:9],"big")
    if 9>=end: return None
    n=data[9]
    if 10+n>end: return None
    qty=bytes(data[10:10+n])
    if any(c<32 or c>126 for c in qty): return None
    rs=10+n
    buf=bytearray(data); k=0xb7
    for i in range(rs,end):
        buf[i]^=k&0xff; k=(k*0x69+0x10)&0xff
    def vi(p):
        v=s=0
        for j in range(5):
            if p>=end: return None
            b=buf[p]; p+=1
            if j==4 and b&0xf0: return None
            v|=(b&0x7f)<<s; s+=7
            if not b&0x80:
                if j and not (b&0x7f): return None
                return v,p
        return None
    p=rs; recs=[]
    for _ in range(cnt):
        r=vi(p)
        if r is None: return None
        sk,p=r
        if p>=end: return None
        m=buf[p]; p+=1
        if p+m>end: return None
        s=bytes(buf[p:p+m]); p+=m
        if any(c<32 or c>126 for c in s): return None
        rec={"sku":sk,"count":s.decode("latin-1")}
        if fl&2:
            if p>=end: return None
            m=buf[p]; p+=1
            if p+m>end: return None
            s=bytes(buf[p:p+m]); p+=m
            if any(c<32 or c>126 for c in s): return None
            rec["owner"]=s.decode("latin-1")
        recs.append(rec)
    if p!=end: return None
    return {"header":{"flags":fl,"qty":qty.decode("latin-1")},"records":recs}

def parse(data: bytes):
    data = bytes(data)
    end = len(data) - 4
    if end < 13: return None
    if data[:4].hex() != '6eb09938' or data[4] != 0xc4: return None
    rem, acc = 1, 0
    for b in data[:end]:
        rem = (rem + b) % 0xc97b; acc = (acc + rem) % 0xc97b
    if ((acc << 16) | rem) != int.from_bytes(data[end:], 'little'): return None
    count = int.from_bytes(data[5:9], 'little')
    if count > 8: return None
    flags = int.from_bytes(data[9:13], 'big')
    def vix(dd, p):
        v = s = 0
        for i in range(5):
            if p >= end: return None, p
            b = dd[p]; p += 1
            if i == 4 and b & 0xf0: return None, p
            v |= (b & 0x7f) << s; s += 7
            if not b & 0x80:
                if i and not b & 0x7f: return None, p
                return v, p
        return None, p
    hsrc, p = vix(data, 13)
    if hsrc is None: return None
    buf = bytearray(data); k = 0x37
    for i in range(p, end):
        buf[i] ^= k & 0xff; k = (k * 0x8b + 0x04) & 0xff
    recs = []
    for _ in range(count):
        src, p = vix(buf, p)
        if src is None or p >= end: return None
        n = buf[p]; p += 1
        if p + n > end: return None
        sb = bytes(buf[p:p+n]); p += n
        if any(c < 32 or c > 126 for c in sb): return None
        r = {'label': sb.decode('ascii'), 'source': src}
        if flags & 0x40:
            ln, p = vix(buf, p)
            if ln is None: return None
            r['length'] = ln
        recs.append(r)
    if p != end: return None
    return {'header': {'flags': flags, 'source': hsrc}, 'records': recs}

def parse(data: bytes):
    data = bytes(data)
    end = len(data) - 4
    if end < 13: return None
    if data[:4].hex() != 'c9a77bfe' or data[4] != 0x9d: return None
    x = 0
    for i in range(0, end, 4):
        x ^= int.from_bytes(data[:end][i:i+4].ljust(4, b'\0'), 'little')
    if x != int.from_bytes(data[end:], 'little'): return None
    count = int.from_bytes(data[5:9], 'little')
    if count > 8: return None
    flags = data[9]; fid = int.from_bytes(data[10:12], 'little')
    def vix(dd, p):
        v = s = 0
        for i in range(5):
            if p >= end: return None, p
            b = dd[p]; p += 1
            if i == 4 and b & 0xf0: return None, p
            v |= (b & 0x7f) << s; s += 7
            if not b & 0x80:
                if i and not b & 0x7f: return None, p
                return v, p
        return None, p
    hck, p = vix(data, 12)
    if hck is None: return None
    buf = bytearray(data); k = 0x2b
    for i in range(p, end):
        buf[i] ^= k & 0xff; k = (k * 0x71 + 0xc4) & 0xff
    recs = []
    for _ in range(count):
        ln, p = vix(buf, p)
        if ln is None or p >= end: return None
        n = buf[p]; p += 1
        if p + n > end: return None
        sb = bytes(buf[p:p+n]); p += n
        if any(c < 32 or c > 126 for c in sb): return None
        if p + 5 > end: return None
        sq = buf[p]; cat = int.from_bytes(buf[p+1:p+5], 'big'); p += 5
        r = {'category': cat, 'code': sb.decode('ascii'), 'length': ln, 'sequence': sq}
        if flags & 0x04:
            if p + 4 > end: return None
            r['version'] = int.from_bytes(buf[p:p+4], 'big'); p += 4
        recs.append(r)
    if p != end: return None
    return {'header': {'checksum': hck, 'flags': flags, 'id': fid}, 'records': recs}

def parse(data: bytes):
    data = bytes(data)
    end = len(data) - 4
    if end < 11: return None
    if data[:4].hex() != '8c25449c' or data[4] != 0x9c: return None
    rem, acc = 1, 0
    for b in data[:end]:
        rem = (rem + b) % 0x9ed0; acc = (acc + rem) % 0x9ed0
    if ((acc << 16) | rem) != int.from_bytes(data[end:], 'little'): return None
    count = int.from_bytes(data[5:9], 'big')
    if count > 8: return None
    flags = int.from_bytes(data[9:11], 'little')
    buf = bytearray(data); k = 0x25
    for i in range(11, end):
        buf[i] ^= k & 0xff; k = (k * 0x65 + 0x8d) & 0xff
    def vi(p):
        v = s = 0
        for i in range(5):
            if p >= end: return None, p
            b = buf[p]; p += 1
            if i == 4 and b & 0xf0: return None, p
            v |= (b & 0x7f) << s; s += 7
            if not b & 0x80:
                if i and not b & 0x7f: return None, p
                return v, p
        return None, p
    def sf(p):
        if p >= end: return None, p
        n = buf[p]; p += 1
        if p + n > end: return None, p
        sb = bytes(buf[p:p+n]); p += n
        if any(c < 32 or c > 126 for c in sb): return None, p
        return sb.decode('ascii'), p
    recs = []; p = 11
    for _ in range(count):
        q, p = vi(p)
        lb, p = sf(p)
        zn, p = sf(p)
        sc, p = sf(p)
        if q is None or lb is None or zn is None or sc is None: return None
        r = {'label': lb, 'qty': q, 'score': sc, 'zone': zn}
        if flags & 0x08:
            if p + 2 > end: return None
            r['flags'] = int.from_bytes(buf[p:p+2], 'little'); p += 2
        recs.append(r)
    if p != end: return None
    return {'header': {'flags': flags}, 'records': recs}

def parse(data):
    data=bytes(data); end=len(data)-4
    if end<10: return None
    if data[:4].hex()!="79b3453b" or data[4]!=0x30: return None
    M=0xa73; rem=1; acc=0
    for b in data[:end]:
        rem=(rem+b)%M; acc=(acc+rem)%M
    if ((acc<<16)|rem)!=int.from_bytes(data[end:end+4],"little"): return None
    cnt=int.from_bytes(data[5:9],"little")
    if not 0<=cnt<=8: return None
    fl=data[9]
    buf=bytearray(data); k=0x2d
    for i in range(10,end):
        buf[i]^=k&0xff; k=(k*0x87+0x97)&0xff
    def vi(p):
        v=s=0
        for j in range(5):
            if p>=end: return None
            b=buf[p]; p+=1
            if j==4 and b&0xf0: return None
            v|=(b&0x7f)<<s; s+=7
            if not b&0x80:
                if j and not (b&0x7f): return None
                return v,p
        return None
    p=10; recs=[]
    for _ in range(cnt):
        r=vi(p)
        if r is None: return None
        reg,p=r
        if p>=end: return None
        n=buf[p]; p+=1
        if p+n>end: return None
        s=bytes(buf[p:p+n]); p+=n
        if any(c<32 or c>126 for c in s): return None
        if p+4>end: return None
        f2=int.from_bytes(buf[p:p+4],"big"); p+=4
        rec={"region":reg,"account_id":s.decode("latin-1"),"flags":f2}
        if fl&2:
            if p+2>end: return None
            rec["id"]=int.from_bytes(buf[p:p+2],"big"); p+=2
        recs.append(rec)
    if p!=end: return None
    return {"header":{"flags":fl},"records":recs}

PREFIX = b'\xd1\x75\x7f\x11\x44\x00'


def parse(data: bytes):
    if len(data) < 13 or data[:6] != PREFIX:
        return None
    count = data[6]
    stock = int.from_bytes(data[7:9], 'little')
    zone = int.from_bytes(data[9:13], 'little')
    pos = 13
    records = []
    for _ in range(count):
        if pos >= len(data):
            return None
        n = data[pos]
        pos += 1
        if pos + n + 13 > len(data):
            return None
        s = data[pos:pos + n]
        pos += n
        if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7E for c in s):
            return None
        records.append({
            'length': s.decode('ascii'),
            'name': int.from_bytes(data[pos + 9:pos + 13], 'big'),
            'owner': int.from_bytes(data[pos + 5:pos + 9], 'big'),
            'price_cents': int.from_bytes(data[pos + 1:pos + 5], 'little'),
            'timestamp': data[pos],
        })
        pos += 13
    if pos != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': {'stock': stock, 'zone': zone}, 'records': records}
EOF

def parse(data):
    data=bytes(data); end=len(data)-4
    if end<8: return None
    if data[:4].hex()!="a9857662" or data[4]!=0x30: return None
    chk=0; pre=data[:end]
    for i in range(0,end,4):
        chk^=int.from_bytes(pre[i:i+4],"little")
    if chk!=int.from_bytes(data[end:end+4],"little"): return None
    cnt=int.from_bytes(data[5:7],"big")
    if not 0<=cnt<=8: return None
    def vih(p):
        v=s=0
        for j in range(5):
            if p>=end: return None
            b=data[p]; p+=1
            if j==4 and b&0xf0: return None
            v|=(b&0x7f)<<s; s+=7
            if not b&0x80:
                if j and not (b&0x7f): return None
                return v,p
        return None
    fl=data[7]
    r=vih(8)
    if r is None: return None
    hchk,rs=r
    buf=bytearray(data); k=0xff
    for i in range(rs,end):
        buf[i]^=k&0xff; k=(k*0xc5+0xbf)&0xff
    def vi(p):
        v=s=0
        for j in range(5):
            if p>=end: return None
            b=buf[p]; p+=1
            if j==4 and b&0xf0: return None
            v|=(b&0x7f)<<s; s+=7
            if not b&0x80:
                if j and not (b&0x7f): return None
                return v,p
        return None
    p=rs; recs=[]
    for _ in range(cnt):
        r=vi(p)
        if r is None: return None
        ic,p=r
        if p>=end: return None
        n=buf[p]; p+=1
        if p+n>end: return None
        s1=bytes(buf[p:p+n]); p+=n
        if any(c<32 or c>126 for c in s1): return None
        r=vi(p)
        if r is None: return None
        seq,p=r
        if p>=end: return None
        n=buf[p]; p+=1

        s2=bytes(buf[p:p+n]); p+=n

        rec={"item_count":ic,"id":s1.decode("latin-1"),"sequence":seq,"status":s2.decode("latin-1")}
        if fl&8:
            if p>=end: return None
            rec["sku"]=buf[p]; p+=1
        recs.append(rec)
    if p!=end: return None
    return {"header":{"flags":fl,"checksum":hchk},"records":recs}

def parse(data):
    data=bytes(data); end=len(data)-4
    if end<15: return None
    if data[:4].hex()!="6f9c5b3d" or data[4]!=0x82: return None
    chk=0; pre=data[:end]
    for i in range(0,end,4):
        chk^=int.from_bytes(pre[i:i+4],"little")
    if chk!=int.from_bytes(data[end:end+4],"little"): return None
    cnt=int.from_bytes(data[5:7],"big")
    if not 0<=cnt<=8: return None
    fl=int.from_bytes(data[7:11],"little")
    bal=int.from_bytes(data[11:15],"big")
    buf=bytearray(data); k=0x4f
    for i in range(15,end):
        buf[i]^=k&0xff; k=(k*0xa9+0xc9)&0xff
    def vi(p):
        v=s=0
        for j in range(5):
            if p>=end: return None
            b=buf[p]; p+=1
            if j==4 and b&0xf0: return None
            v|=(b&0x7f)<<s; s+=7
            if not b&0x80:
                if j and not (b&0x7f): return None
                return v,p
        return None
    p=15; recs=[]
    for _ in range(cnt):
        r=vi(p)
        if r is None: return None
        src,p=r
        rec={"source":src}
        if fl&4:
            if p>=end: return None
            n=buf[p]; p+=1
            if p+n>end: return None
            s=bytes(buf[p:p+n]); p+=n
            if any(c<32 or c>126 for c in s): return None
            rec["owner"]=s.decode("latin-1")
        recs.append(rec)
    if p!=end: return None
    return {"header":{"flags":fl,"balance":bal},"records":recs}

PREFIX = b'\x86\x69\x44\x8a\x19\x00\x00\x00'


def _str(data, pos):
    n = data[pos]
    pos += 1
    if n < 1 or pos + n > len(data):
        return None, pos
    s = data[pos:pos + n]
    pos += n
    if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7E for c in s):
        return None, pos
    return s.decode('ascii'), pos


def parse(data: bytes):
    if len(data) < 13 or data[:8] != PREFIX:
        return None
    count = data[8]
    header = {'balance': data[12], 'id': int.from_bytes(data[10:12], 'little'), 'zone': data[9]}
    pos = 13
    records = []
    for _ in range(count):
        if pos >= len(data):
            return None
        name, pos = _str(data, pos)
        if name is None or pos >= len(data):
            return None
        checksum, pos = _str(data, pos)
        if checksum is None or pos + 5 > len(data):
            return None
        records.append({
            'checksum': checksum,
            'name': name,
            'priority': int.from_bytes(data[pos + 1:pos + 5], 'big'),
            'rating': data[pos],
        })
        pos += 5
    if pos != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': header, 'records': records}
EOF

PREFIX = b'\x0e\xbc\x39\x7b\x3f'


def _str(data, pos):
    n = data[pos]
    pos += 1
    if n < 1 or pos + n > len(data):
        return None, pos
    s = data[pos:pos + n]
    pos += n
    if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7E for c in s):
        return None, pos
    return s.decode('ascii'), pos


def parse(data: bytes):
    if len(data) < 10 or data[:5] != PREFIX or data[6:9] != b'\x00\x00\x00':
        return None
    count = data[5]
    header = {'region': data[9]}
    pos = 10
    records = []
    for _ in range(count):
        if pos >= len(data):
            return None
        seq, pos = _str(data, pos)
        if seq is None or pos + 9 > len(data):
            return None
        score = int.from_bytes(data[pos:pos + 4], 'big')
        checksum = data[pos + 4]
        temperature = int.from_bytes(data[pos + 5:pos + 9], 'big')
        pos += 9
        if pos >= len(data):
            return None
        name, pos = _str(data, pos)
        if name is None:
            return None
        records.append({'checksum': checksum, 'name': name, 'score': score, 'sequence': seq, 'temperature': temperature})
    if pos != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': header, 'records': records}
EOF

PREFIX = b'\x11\x60\xfe\xa4\x78\x00\x00\x00'


def parse(data: bytes):

        return None
    count = data[8]
    header = {
        'enabled': int.from_bytes(data[13:17], 'little'),
        'name': int.from_bytes(data[9:13], 'little'),
    }
    pos = 17
    records = []
    for _ in range(count):
        if pos >= len(data):
            return None
        n = data[pos]
        pos += 1
        if pos + n + 5 > len(data):
            return None
        s = data[pos:pos + n]
        pos += n
        if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7E for c in s):
            return None
        records.append({
            'count': data[pos],
            'item_count': int.from_bytes(data[pos + 1:pos + 5], 'little'),
            'score': s.decode('ascii'),
        })
        pos += 5
    if pos != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': header, 'records': records}

            'sequence': int.from_bytes(data[pos + 3:pos + 5], 'big'),
            'source': data[pos],
        })
        pos += 5
    if pos != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': header, 'records': records}

PREFIX = b'\x5b\xb8\xeb\x5b\x58'


def _str(data, pos, allow_empty):
    n = data[pos]
    pos += 1
    if (not allow_empty and n < 1) or pos + n > len(data):
        return None, pos
    s = data[pos:pos + n]
    pos += n
    if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7E for c in s):
        return None, pos
    return s.decode('ascii'), pos


def parse(data: bytes):
    if len(data) < 11 or data[:5] != PREFIX or data[6:9] != b'\x00\x00\x00':
        return None
    count = data[5]
    header = {'created_at': int.from_bytes(data[9:11], 'little')}
    pos = 11
    records = []
    for _ in range(count):
        if pos >= len(data):
            return None
        s1, pos = _str(data, pos, False)
        if s1 is None or pos + 6 > len(data):
            return None
        checksum = int.from_bytes(data[pos:pos + 2], 'big')
        timestamp = int.from_bytes(data[pos + 2:pos + 4], 'big')
        flags = int.from_bytes(data[pos + 4:pos + 6], 'little')
        pos += 6
        if pos >= len(data):
            return None
        s2, pos = _str(data, pos, True)
        if s2 is None:
            return None
        records.append({'checksum': checksum, 'created_at': s1, 'flags': flags, 'owner': s2, 'timestamp': timestamp})
    if pos != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': header, 'records': records}

PREFIX = b'\x0f\x1b\x5c\x02\x02\x00\x00\x00'


def parse(data: bytes):
    if len(data) < 12 or data[:8] != PREFIX:
        return None
    count = data[8]
    header = {'category': int.from_bytes(data[9:11], 'little'), 'score': data[11]}
    pos = 12
    records = []
    for _ in range(count):
        if pos >= len(data):
            return None
        n = data[pos]
        pos += 1
        if n < 1 or pos + n + 1 > len(data):
            return None
        s = data[pos:pos + n]
        pos += n
        if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7E for c in s):
            return None
        records.append({'label': data[pos], 'source': s.decode('ascii')})
        pos += 1
    if pos != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': header, 'records': records}
EOF

M = 0xFFFFFFFF

def keygen(name):
    h = 0x25B4B16B
    for ch in name:
        c = ord(ch)
        h = (h * 0x5FFA2FCD + c) & M
        h = (h * 0xE2085BCD + c * 0x20021) & M
    h ^= h >> 25
    h = (h * 0x06890F21) & M
    h ^= h >> 20
    return '%04X-%04X' % (h >> 16, h & 0xFFFF)
EOF

cd /app/repo && cat > keygen.py <<'EOF'
M = 0xFFFFFFFF
TABLE = [0xE953EC46, 0x15155D21, 0x256357FA, 0x8AD078D5, 0x5402A97B, 0x9CFABCDC, 0x976F19A9, 0x38EAEFB9, 0x5CFAC778, 0xE2087057, 0xC214460D, 0x6E551D19, 0x434B5B0F, 0x4F248556, 0xF06A36C0, 0x9E97E762]

def rol(x, n):
    return ((x << n) | (x >> (32 - n))) & M

def keygen(name):
    h = 0x0FBDCF2D
    for i, ch in enumerate(name):
        c = ord(ch)
        h = (h + (c << 7)) & M
        h ^= TABLE[(c + i) & 15]
        h = rol(h, 2) ^ c
        h = rol(h, 8) ^ c
    h ^= h >> 17
    h = (h * 0x32512B8D) & M
    h ^= h >> 13
    return '%04X-%04X' % (h >> 16, h & 0xFFFF)
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
import random, string, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from keygen import keygen
assert keygen('T4j3fD7KX') == 'AFFF-1F45', keygen('T4j3fD7KX')
random.seed(13)
bad = 0
for _ in range(400):
    n = ''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits) for _ in range(random.randint(3, 16)))
    if subprocess.run(['./check', n, keygen(n)], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() != 'ACCEPTED':
        bad += 1
        print('FAIL', n)
        if bad > 3: break
print('done, failures:', bad)
EOF
